summary: Official national and local custodial evidence was found, including the current Geoportal LMB Parcel data layer, but anonymous parcel schema/CRS/geometry access was not verified and no sample was retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Filipino/Cebuano discovery queries and actual URLs are recorded in city-5894-tagum.json.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official Geoportal viewer HTML retrieved; current JavaScript imports loader/map modules and identifies the public Geoportal application.
Official viewer JavaScript retrieved; it uses https://geoserver.geoportal.gov.ph/geoserver/geoportal/wms and exposes layer-registry routes.

Current public layer registry retrieved. It contains agency LMB, layer name denr_parcel_data, title Parcel data, style ParcelData. The registry did not expose a native ID field, geometry field or CRS.
Agency-grouped layer registry retrieved; LMB Parcel data was present. No parcel feature payload was returned by this metadata endpoint.
WMS-link metadata endpoint retrieved; no parcel geometry or safe parcel identity response was returned.
Anonymous public WMS capabilities request timed out after 20 seconds; TLS verification remained enabled and no exception was used.
Anonymous public WFS capabilities request timed out after 8 seconds; no schema, CRS, IDs or geometry obtained.
Alternate anonymous WFS capabilities route timed out after 8 seconds; no retry escalation, credentials, CAPTCHA or bypass used.
Official Tagum directory was found by first-party search and identifies the City Assessor's Office, but direct curl timed out; no login or bypass attempted.
Official LMB FOI search result was found by search and records Tagum tax-mapping and approved subdivision-plan requests; direct retrieval returned 403, so no restricted content was accessed.

requestCoordinates.coordinateOrderNote: WUP point preserved as latitude/longitude. No coordinate shift applied; no exact-point parcel query completed.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if exposed
geometryQuality: No parcel geometry response obtained; zero samples retained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not completed because the current Geoportal GeoServer capabilities routes timed out; this is not evidence of parcel absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Philippine LMB/DENR Geoportal parcel layer plus Tagum City tax-mapping/cadastral custodians.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official viewer, current layer registry, local assessor directory evidence and LMB records were identified; anonymous parcel schema, CRS, stable identity, geometry and citywide coverage remain unverified.

scopeLimits: A registry entry, zero exact-point hits, service timeout, 403, or unusable endpoint does not establish citywide parcel absence.
The LMB layer is national/general infrastructure; Tagum local assessor evidence identifies a custodian but not an open parcel API.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, title, tax/account, personal or unsafe fields were requested, logged or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not admit a runtime adapter.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review remains required
uncertainty: The current Geoportal advertises an LMB parcel layer, but anonymous GeoServer capabilities requests timed out. Stable native identity, field mapping, CRS, geometry availability, parcel completeness, legal status and update currency remain unknown.
